# AccountingCoach

> > Free online accounting education platform offering comprehensive courses, tutorials, and professional certification through AccountingCoach PRO membership.

AccountingCoach is founded by Harold Averkamp (CPA, MBA) and provides free and premium accounting education covering fundamentals through advanced topics. The platform combines interactive learning materials, practice quizzes, expert Q&A, and a comprehensive accounting dictionary to serve both individual learners and teams.

## Key Topics

- Accounting Basics
- Bookkeeping Fundamentals
- Double-Entry Accounting
- Financial Statements
- Debits and Credits
- Chart of Accounts
- Accounting Equation
- Accounting Principles
- Balance Sheet
- General Ledger
- Financial Accounting
- AccountingCoach PRO
- Certificates
- Study Materials
- Learning Resources
